user.title: ProVent RC7 Premium
user.description: Connect to the ProVent WebManipulator (the recuperator's web module) on your local network.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the WebManipulator, e.g. 192.168.1.50
data_description.port: HTTP port of the web module (usually 80)
data_description.api_path: Path to the PHP API scripts (default /api)
data_description.use_ssl: Enable if the web module is served over HTTPS

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the host, port and API path, and that the WebManipulator is reachable.
error.timeout: The device did not respond in time.

abort.already_configured: This ProVent device is already configured.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends a raw command to the ProVent WebManipulator, identical to the official app (fan gear, bypass, season, boost, setpoints, etc.).

command.name: Command
command.description: Command string, e.g. spd:b2 (fan gear 2), spd:w1 (start airing/boost), nag:T25 (heating setpoint 25 °C), bps:ta (bypass auto).

entry_id.name: Target device
entry_id.description: Which ProVent device to send to, if more than one is configured.

validate.name: Validate
validate.description: Validate the command against known command groups and value ranges before sending.
